findings.title: Following an informed guide
findings.claim: Within the pericope, following an informed guide becomes a disciplined relation in which sound judgment and explanation are not immediately available at every step.
findings.mechanism: The focus following, sound-judgment, and received-knowledge carriers contact the supplied patience, incomplete-grasp, inward-knowledge, request, and timed-disclosure occurrences.
findings.reader_payoff: The request to follow becomes an agreement to remain with a guide through scenes whose meaning is not yet available.
findings.containment: The ordinary request to accompany and learn remains intact; the contextual branches are bounded to the supplied pericope and no universal moral value is assigned to following.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel support and exact focus surface ground the relation, while the pedagogical synthesis remains a bounded context reading.
